observations.title: Help a downed teammate before death completes
observations.player_action: Approach a teammate in PlayerRevive's recoverable state and use its installed revive interaction before the configured window expires.
observations.outcome: Upstream provides a limited rescue window instead of immediately finalizing every fatal incident.
conditions: The project page does not specify the interaction key or full 2.0.31 rules; do not invent them.
JEM hosted-boss actual death must still eliminate immediately; this research does not override that canonical rule.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Distinguish downed, revived and actual-death transitions from native PlayerRevive/Forge signals before quest design. A health threshold alone is not a safe detection mechanism.
